import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Job data
jobs = {
    0: {"processing_time": 41, "due_date": 164, "weight": 2},
    1: {"processing_time": 60, "due_date": 100, "weight": 8},
    2: {"processing_time": 49, "due_date": 103, "weight": 5},
    3: {"processing_time": 72, "due_date": 163, "weight": 2},
    4: {"processing_time": 13, "due_date": 187, "weight": 9},
    5: {"processing_time": 38, "due_date": 91, "weight": 5},
    6: {"processing_time": 19, "due_date": 194, "weight": 1},
    7: {"processing_time": 20, "due_date": 143, "weight": 2},
    8: {"processing_time": 76, "due_date": 214, "weight": 7},
    9: {"processing_time": 39, "due_date": 245, "weight": 7}
}

# Create a new model
model = gp.Model("single_machine_scheduling")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Create variables
n = len(jobs)
x = model.addVars(n, n, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")
C = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="C")
T = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="T")

# Set objective
model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(jobs[j]["weight"] * T[j] for j in range(n)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Add constraints
model.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for j in range(n)) == 1 for i in range(n)), name="assign_once")
model.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[j, i] for j in range(n)) == 1 for i in range(n)), name="assigned_once")

model.addConstrs((C[j] >= jobs[j]["processing_time"] + gp.quicksum(jobs[i]["processing_time"] * x[i, j] for i in range(n)) - (1 - x[j, j]) * sum(jobs[i]["processing_time"] for i in range(n)) for j in range(n)), name="completion_time")

model.addConstrs((T[j] >= C[j] - jobs[j]["due_date"] for j in range(n)), name="tardiness")

# Optimize model
model.optimize()

# Extract the sequence
sequence = [j for j in range(n) for i in range(n) if x[i, j].X > 0.5]

# Extract the objective value
objective_value = model.ObjVal

# Print the result
import json
print(json.dumps({"sequence": sequence, "objective_value": objective_value}))
